sloka: तथैवापततां तेषां कपीनामसिभिः शितैः।शिरांसि सहसा जह्नू राक्षसा भीमदर्शनाः ।। ६.७५.६२ ।।
transliteration: tathaivāpatatāṁ teṣāṁ kapīnāmasibhiḥ śitaiḥ।śirāṁsi sahasā jahnū rākṣasā bhīmadarśanāḥ ।। 6.75.62 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter the monkeys eager to fight with night rangers rose as if gone mad striking the night rangers with trees and rocks.
